description: Search your persistent memory for relevant information. Use this at the start of any task to check what you already know, or when you need context about past decisions, known issues, or architectural patterns. Prefer format="compact" for discovery; use memories action="get" for full originals.

after.description: Include records created at or after this ISO timestamp.

before.description: Include records created at or before this ISO timestamp.

explain.description: Include retrieval reasons in compact output.

format.description: Optional compact, budgeted excerpts. Default preserves full legacy output.

include_sessions.description: Override session chunk search. Auto-triggers on temporal queries or sparse results. Set true to force, false to disable.

limit.description: Number of results. User configured: 5. OMIT this parameter to respect the user's setting. Only override if the user explicitly asks for a different count.

min_score.description: Minimum similarity score 0-1. User configured: 0.3. OMIT to use configured setting.

project.description: Optional: filter by project. If omitted, searches all projects but boosts current project.

query.description: What to search for, in natural language.

recency_boost.description: Prioritize recent memories. User configured: OFF. OMIT to use configured setting. Shifts scoring to favor recency over semantic similarity (14-day half-life, 55% recency weight). Ideal for session-start boot queries.

rerank.description: Judge the shortlist for relevance after retrieval and reorder it. Slower — worth it when the query is subtle and the top hits look interchangeable.

scope.description: Project requires an explicit project or caller context; never widens the search.

tag_match.description: Match any tag (default) or require every tag.

token_budget.description: Total estimated output tokens for compact format; default 1500.

name: recall
